If you are ordering outside the UK, international standard delivery costs £9.95 [KB-113].
Do you do next day delivery?

events.query: Do you do next day delivery?

Is delivery free?

events.query: Is delivery free?

events.text: Delivery can be free depending on your order! Standard delivery is free for orders over £40 [KB-101]. Otherwise, standard delivery costs £3.95 and express delivery costs £7.95 [KB-101].
How long does a sofa take to arrive?

events.query: How long does a sofa take to arrive?

events.text: Large items like sofas are delivered by a two-person courier service. According to our help centre, these shipments generally take between 5 to 10 working days [KB-101]. Please remember that delivery times start counting from the day your order is dispatched.

events.text: Hello! While we do deliver to Ireland, unfortunately, Express delivery is not available outside of the UK [KB-113]. You can still choose standard international delivery, which takes 5 to 8 working days [KB-113].
Will I have to pay customs on an order to France?

events.query: Will I have to pay customs on an order to France?

How long do I have to return something?

events.query: How long do I have to return something?

events.text: You can return most items within **30 days of delivery** for a refund, provided they are unused and still in their original packaging [KB-104]. events.text: To return your rug, please ensure it is unused and in its original packaging, and you are within 30 days of delivery [KB-104]. Is it free to return something from Ireland?

events.text: Thanks for asking! Unfortunately, returns from Ireland and the EU do cost £6.95, which will be taken from your refund [KB-104]. For UK addresses, returns are free.

events.text:
The delivery cost is refunded only when the whole order is returned, or when the item was damaged, faulty or lost [KB-105].

I can process a refund for the delivery cost of £3.95 for your damaged order. I have issued this refund now, which will arrive in 5 to 10 working days.
How do I get my money back for the pillow? I opened it and don't like it.

events.query: How do I get my money back for the pillow? I opened it and don't like it.

events.text: Hello! Regarding the pillow, unfortunately, we are unable to accept returns for pillows once they have been taken out of their sealed packaging, due to hygiene and safety reasons [KB-109]. Please let me know if you have any questions about a different item or our other policies.
What time do you close on Saturday?

events.query: What time do you close on Saturday?

events.text: Good afternoon. On Saturdays, the customer care team is available until 4pm UK time. You can find the full hours for our customer care team in the help-centre articles [KB-112]. Let me know if you have any other questions about orders or policies!

events.text: Est-ce que vous livrez en France ?

events.query: Est-ce que vous livrez en France ?

events.text: Yes, we do deliver to France! [KB-113]. International standard delivery takes 5 to 8 working days and costs £9.95. Please remember that all duties and taxes for EU orders are included in the price, so you won't have to pay anything extra on delivery.
The rug I ordered smells of chemicals, is that normal? HL-10244 chloe.martin@example.com

events.query: The rug I ordered smells of chemicals, is that normal? HL-10244 chloe.martin@example.com

events.text: I'm so sorry to hear that your rug has such an unpleasant smell. We certainly don't want you to receive anything that isn't perfect. To help us look into this fault, could you confirm the total cost of the rug? Once I have that information, I can issue a refund for the faulty item, up to £50 for this order.
